xs.$description: Tightest gap or padding (4px). Works for padding and gaps.

sm.$description: Small gap or padding (8px). Works for padding and gaps.

md.$description: Default padding inside controls (12px). Works for padding and gaps.

lg.$description: Default gap between blocks and padding inside cards (16px). Works for padding and gaps.

xl.$description: Roomy padding and gaps between groups (24px). Works for padding and gaps.

2xl.$description: Gap between sections (32px). Works for padding and gaps.

3xl.$description: Largest gap, for page-level separation (48px). Works for padding and gaps.
